corrected_headline: A CORE is a criterion set of size > 1 that ③ consumes no prompt-specific labels and ② beats a NAMED prompt-blind comparator by a resolvably positive margin — its bootstrap CI lower bound above zero. ⚠ On this release that admits 28 arms including the core, of which 25 are procedurally distinct; the set spans 1.6 effective dimensions against 3.6 for a random 25, and its closest member clears the boundary by 0.28 MDE.
